documents: name.strip() | description.strip() | skill_md.strip(); original baseline 32768-token right limit, including two historical truncated test documents
queries: original instruction and complete query; left padding, last nonpadding token, FP32 normalization
development: seed5150 source-repository/identity/normalized-body components, 80/10/10 hash partition; 512 selection and 512 confirmation queries, all 10123 train-origin skills as evaluation candidates; updates and negative mining exclude both development skill partitions
query_objective: float32 softmax over ALL eligible frozen train-document vectors; target probability uniform across ALL known positives; temperature .05; mean cross entropy plus 1*(1-cos(adapted,base))
mixture_deployment: weight in (0,1) requires separate base and adapted query encodings, normalized after weighted sum; document index remains frozen
query_promote: pilot positive selection NDCG; choose checkpoint and mixture on selection only; confirmation evaluated once after recipe/checkpoint lock; confirmation point gain and paired interval reported, no confirmation-driven retuning
reranker_renderer: deterministic label-blind lexical selection from complete original SKILL.md with original source offsets, metadata and full query/suffix reserved; same rule for positives, negatives and all partitions
reranker_full_coverage_development_ablat: sequential bounded body windows, max skill score, report length bias and throughput; promote only if development gain justifies cost
reranker_objective: skill-level binary cross entropy on logit(yes)-logit(no); balanced alternating positive/negative pairs; negatives mixture high 60%, moderate 30%, random 10%; all known and content-equivalent positives excluded
fusion: development-only rank-percentile normalized dense and reranker scores; convex weights [0,.25,.5,.75,1], deterministic original dense rank tie break; dense-only included
confirmation: one use after freezing selection choices, not checkpoint/hyperparameter selection; pretrained models may already have seen this public training partition
primary_test_comparison: one trained challenger selected on development, versus archived frozen SkillRet-0.6B; retain unchanged released-reranker and embedding controls; freeze FINAL_EVAL_LOCK before any new official scores

bootstrap.limitations: conditional on selected recipes and fixed dataset; excludes full seed/selection/pretraining/exposed-test uncertainty

test_policy: 4392 queries, 6006 original ordered skills, 7187 exact-ID positives, no candidate gold injection, no tuning after final results, fixed denominator failures count zero
scaling: secondary original 20-question eight saved pools with exact historical membership/source labels
resource_policy: one resident model; low-memory CUDA loading; no BF16/FlashAttention2/math fallback; >=1GiB host RAM and ~0.5GiB GPU reserves; guard owns only experiment children; no services changed
publication: direct main as explicitly authorized, preserve all old study bytes, staged-only gitleaks scan, compact adapters/vectors via Git LFS

reranker_inference_batch.selection: Non-test synthetic throughput/memory and score parity only. 10 admitted if both1024/2048 are at least5% faster for20pairs, max logit difference error<.02 and CUDA reserved<7GiB. Otherwise4. Same selected batch for all released/trained/dev/final reranker inference.

reranker_inference_validation: tiny padded-batch scores and gradients compared to official full-vocabulary reference before any development scoring
reranker_policy_selection_rule: Compare all512 selection queries for1024/2048 selected evidence and20/50 dense candidates. Choose highest end-to-end selection NDCG, ties fewer candidates, smaller budget, lower rerank fusion weight. Full-coverage2048/top20 replaces selected evidence only with >=.005 NDCG gain and <=2x median measured rendering+reranking time at the selected candidate count. All choices precede confirmation and official scoring.
reranker_training_promotion_rule: Run100-step BCE pilot against own released checkpoint on identical inputs/pools. Promote a fresh <=600-step run only if selection NDCG improves over the released starting checkpoint under the selected policy; otherwise preserve the pilot as a negative training result.
reranker_full_coverage_gradient: For a skill-level max, no-grad scores for all windows retain per-window CPU/CUDA RNG state; replay only first-argmax window with gradient, restore post-scoring RNG; independently validate scores, scaled gradients and dropout RNG against naive retained-graph max on tiny fixtures.
latency_sample: 20 lowest SHA256(latency_seed42,query_id) official query IDs after final lock; actual application-uncached query inference + model switching + selected-evidence reranking, one resident model; report this sample separately from component-summed full-test times
reranker_positive_policy: For each training query, iterate ALL known positive skill IDs in sorted order, each followed by one sampled negative. Bounded runs may stop between query groups; report actual coverage. BCE reduction is mean over pairs, with equal positive/negative counts, not one arbitrarily retained target per multi-positive query.
deterministic_training: Strict torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, same efficient CUDA SDPA and no fallback. An initial non-deterministic backward fixture was discarded. The corrected real 4-step vs 2+reload+2 fixture passed byte-exactly before quality pilots.
reranker_short_window_policy: Keep an entire short source window when it fits; only truncated fragments need at least 32 tokens.
reranker_budget_admission: 1024 must pass real forward/backward/update and batch-4 inference. If the optional 2048 probe cannot fit, retain its resource failure and use 1024 for all policies, including the complete-window alternative. Batch-10 OOM never promotes batch 10.
deployment_confirmation_gate: The selection-only recommendation must beat frozen dense with a positive paired interval on the independent panel. Each active local training component must also beat its matched unchanged starting checkpoint with a positive interval. Otherwise retain frozen dense deployment. This never changes the locked primary research contrast or selects another checkpoint.
secondary_seed_rule: Repeat each selected seed42 recipe with seed43 through its exact selected optimizer step, preserving the full original schedule length and fixed candidate/renderer/fusion/mixture choices. Record the fixed query checkpoint development vectors for replay. The fixed reranker repeat needs no new development selection scoring. No reselection of stopping point or seed.
reranker_reload_fixture: A fresh process checks exact candidate/input/logit/ranking parity on the first 64 frozen selection query IDs, fixed before any trained reranker validation result. The actual trained checkpoint quality still uses the complete 512-query panel.
reference_rounding_acceptance: Compare all 4,392 archived ranks and all 219,600 archived top-50 scores aligned by skill ID after one reconstruction. Automatic continuation requires identical top 10 on every query, identical shared metrics at 5 and 10, every aligned score within 1e-5, and every changed tail-order margin within 2e-5. Otherwise stop for review using the same cached bytes. Never re-embed or change the archived primary reference.
